title: Overview of Elon Musk Terafab Construction Plan
description: Recent reports detail plans for a massive construction project involving Elon Musk, SpaceX, and Tesla in Texas.

sources.title: Elon Musk Plans to Spend $119 Billion to Construct the World’s Largest Building, Just Outside Houston
SpaceX and Tesla choose Texas for AI chip manufacturing plant that will be world's largest building
Musk’s Terafab chip plant will run on gas, not Tesla solar

sections.heading: Project Scale and Investment
paragraphs: According to Yahoo Finance, Elon Musk plans to spend $119 billion to construct the world's largest building just outside Houston. Fox Business reports that SpaceX and Tesla have chosen Texas for an AI chip manufacturing plant that will be the world's largest building.

sections.heading: Location Details
paragraphs: The project is set to take place in Texas. Yahoo Finance specifies that the construction will occur just outside Houston, while Fox Business confirms the selection of Texas for the AI chip manufacturing facility.

sections.heading: Power Source
paragraphs: Regarding the energy for the facility, Electrek reports that Musk’s Terafab chip plant will run on gas, not Tesla solar.

faq.q: What is the estimated cost of the construction plan?
faq.a: According to Yahoo Finance, the plan involves spending $119 billion.

faq.q: Where is the Terafab plant being built?
faq.a: Yahoo Finance reports the location is just outside Houston, and Fox Business confirms the site is in Texas.

faq.q: What type of plant is being constructed?
faq.a: Fox Business states that it is an AI chip manufacturing plant.
